C1521.title: Inferno Drainer Exploits EIP-7702 Upgrade for New Phishing Attack
C1521.summary: On May 24, 2025, the phishing group Inferno Drainer leveraged the Ethereum EIP-7702 upgrade to carry out a novel attack, resulting in a single loss of approximately $150,000. EIP-7702 allows externally owned accounts (EOAs) to temporarily gain smart contract functionality, and attackers used an authorized MetaMask to trick users into signing malicious approvals, thereby transferring assets.
